title: Amazon Best Sellers

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Category slugs from the marketplace chart URL, e.g. ["electronics"] or ["kitchen"]. Use ONE category per run when every chart membership/rank matters: the same ASIN appears only once across all categories in one run. Multiple categories are useful for a deduplicated product list, not complete independent charts. Default 2 pages with fillRanks=true requests Top 100 per category at up to $0.40; filters, source issues and spending caps can reduce coverage. Unknown slugs yield free status rows.

chart.title: Chart
chart.description: "bestsellers" (default) = the Best Sellers chart (standing sales rank). "new_releases" = the New Releases chart (newest products gaining traction). Movers & Shakers, Most Wished For and Gift Ideas are not available.

domain.title: Marketplace
domain.description: Marketplace, e.g. "de" for amazon.de. Default "com". One of: com, co.uk, de, fr, it, es, ca, com.au, co.jp, in, com.mx, com.br, nl, se, pl, sa, ae, sg, com.tr, com.be. Charts and currency are that marketplace's own. With RESIDENTIAL proxies the run routes through the marketplace's country automatically.

pages.title: Pages per category
pages.description: Chart pages per category, 1 to 20, e.g. 2 (default 2 = ranks 1 to 100). A page holds 50 ranks (30 rendered + 20 lazy-loaded, both delivered while fillRanks is on). Walking stops early when a page adds nothing new. Cost = pages × 50 × $0.004 per category.
pages.sectionCaption: How many rows, which rows (filters run before billing)

maxResultsPerCategory.title: Max products per category
maxResultsPerCategory.description: 0 (default) keeps all collected entries within pages. N keeps the first N by chart rank BEFORE minRating and run-wide ASIN deduplication, so fewer can be delivered. It does not refill removed rows. For Top 100 use 100 (or 0), pages 2 and fillRanks=true with minRating 0. One category per run preserves independent chart memberships. At most N × $0.004 per category for N>0; set the separate run monetary cap as well.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Keep only entries rated at or above this, e.g. 4. 0 (default) = every entry. Entries whose rating could not be read are dropped too. Filtered entries are never charged.

fillRanks.title: Complete every rank
fillRanks.description: true (DEFAULT) = complete every rank: Amazon renders 30 of a page's 50 entries and lazy-loads 20; the run makes the page's own load-more call (one small request per page, product pages only as a fallback) so the chart has no gaps. false = only the 30 rendered entries per page, one request, ranks 31 to 50 missing. Keep true for "the top 100".

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Parallel proxy sessions (one egress IP each), 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default 4). More is faster for long category lists; each session is paced separately.

perIp.title: Requests per second per IP
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 2 (default 0.5). Amazon tolerates about 0.5/s per IP; faster causes captchas, not speed. Leave the default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy, default {"useApifyProxy": true} (datacentre). Required: Amazon captchas unrotated datacentre traffic; the run rotates the IP on a captcha or 503 and after two refusals in a row moves to residential proxies by itself, routed through the marketplace's country. Pass {"useApifyProxy": true, "apifyProxyGroups": ["RESIDENTIAL"]} for the most reliable runs.

description: Amazon Best Sellers/New Releases charts. For independent category rank histories, use ONE category per run: ASINs are delivered once across all categories in a run. Example: {"categories":["electronics"],"pages":2,"fillRanks":true,"maxResultsPerCategory":100}. Up to 100 rows × $0.004 = $0.40. Keep domain, chart, category, asin, rank and fetched_at. Caps apply before minRating. Inspect status/coverage; no sales-unit estimate. Set callOptions.maxTotalChargeUsd outside input in MCP.
